bayts.text: O Loving (Al-Wadūd), be for me forever with love, and protect me from harm and toil.
You have effaced from me hurt and harm; from me You have accepted the fair pearls.
Turn toward me the reward of the Everlasting, with the reward of the joy of the foremost.
My earning is the affirmation of Oneness and praise of the Prophet — upon him peace — O Forgiver of the sinner.
Forgive, by the standing of the Chosen, all who have loved me for the Countenance of the Owner of time.
O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ), through me benefit all who have attached themselves (to me), O You Who guided me through the Prophet and set (me) free.
I ask You for the Garden, through the Chosen, for whoever takes refuge in me, in concealment.
For Your noble Countenance grant me all that I have asked of You, and teach all of me.
To You is my address, certain that I am an intimate and a beloved, winner of favour.
You have guided me with the guidance of the guides, and led to me the wish of the masters.
You softened hearts for me through the Chosen, and for me with "Be" You convey what is sought.
"Be", and it is, bestows on me from You what gladdens: I am already pleased with You.
I am the guest of the Generous, and my hospitality is good, by the standing of him whose mark is "the Perfumed" (al-Muṭayyab).
The Chosen and the Family, together with his Companions, lead to me a hospitality that guards my hope.
Upon him who accompanied me on my journey (be) the blessing of an Everlasting One Who leads my provisions to me.
Write for whoever has taken my wird, O Generous, practising it, a reward that does not depart.
O my Lord, place the disciples together in Your impregnable fortress, and gather what is scattered.
Give them all mastery over their souls, without anything that harms, and accept the strivings.
Forgive everyone who has inclined toward me, and do not remove wealth from his hands.
You have benefited me: so benefit the household through me, O You Who have encompassed the trustworthy and the princes.
Be for me with what surpasses all expectation, O Best Enricher, Who gifts with favour.
Extend Your two greetings of peace, with the best love, upon him who effaced from me hurt as well as toil.
